children: Helio Corp /FL/ reported results for 2026 showing revenue of $590.63K and a diluted loss per share of ($0.29) as the company continued to operate at a loss, recording a net loss of ($1.47M) for the period.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue declined materially year over year, driven by lower contract volume and a smaller customer base.
Customer concentration increased: work was concentrated among six clients in the current period versus eleven in the prior period.
Operations remain heavily exposed to NASA and federal programs; proposed federal and NASA funding cuts create uncertainty for future contract flow.
Cost of revenue as a percentage of sales improved, roughly 20% lower year to date, reflecting efficiencies on new Q3 2026 contracts.
Company continued delivery of space‑flight hardware and services, including antennas, deployables and integration/testing for NASA and commercial missions.
